title: Indonesia’s Merdeka says its gold subsidiary will launch $300M IPO
body: Its flagship mine in Pani Mountain in Sulawesi is estimated to have 7 million ounces of gold resources.

title: Anglo-Peabody mine tussle leaves Indonesian mining firm seeking new coal assets
body: PT Buma Internasional is still on the hunt for coal assets, as uncertainty lingers about its planned purchase of a stake in the Dawson project.

title: South32 sees limited risk of Indonesia replicating nickel success in alumina
body: South32 reported a 75% surge in full-year profit on Thursday, helped by strong performance at its alumina division and higher commodity prices.

title: Freeport Indonesia to wrap up Gresik plant repairs by early September
body: Freeport expects to complete early next month repair work at its JV smelter in East Java.

title: Indonesia scraps coal pricing rules after pushback from buyers
body: Miners will now be allowed to sell below government-set benchmarks.

title: Freeport Indonesia to ramp up concentrate exports ahead of ban
body: The firm has exported about 65% of the quota as of mid-August.

title: Nickel surpasses coal as Indonesia’s top export, Macquarie says
body: Earnings from overseas sales of nickel products were $16.5 billion in the first half of the year.

title: Indonesia Emphasizes Collaboration and Regional Strategy to Boost Electric Vehicle Ecosystem in Southeast Asia
body: The 2nd Automotive Electrical Indonesia Summit highlighted the importance of collaboration, regional strategy, and innovation in boosting Indonesia's electric vehicle ecosystem, with experts emphasizing the need for standardized policies and international cooperation to support the growth of the industry. Indonesia is poised to become a major player in the regional electric vehicle market, with its large market size and abundant nickel resources, but requires strategic investments and sustainable business models to achieve this goal.

title: Nickel Industries Ltd. Expands into Class 1 Nickel Production to Support Electric Vehicle Battery Development
body: Nickel Industries Ltd. has begun operating a project to produce class 1 nickel, a key component in electric vehicle batteries, with plans to integrate it with the local steel and metal industry and achieve commercial production by early 2026. The company's strategy aims to strengthen Indonesia's position in the global electric vehicle supply chain and support the world's energy transition efforts.

title: Indonesia Aims to Dominate Global Nickel Industry with Strategic National Management
body: Indonesia has the potential to become a major player in the global nickel industry, with over 700 million tons of nickel reserves and 54 smelter facilities, but faces challenges such as dependence on imports and high production costs. The Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI) is pushing for a strategic national management plan to optimize nickel production and processing, with projected prices ranging from $15,000 to $16,000 per ton in 2026.

title: Indonesian Government Discusses Implementation of B40 Biodiesel Program with Mining Industry Stakeholders
body: The Indonesian government, through the Directorate General of New, Renewable, and Energy Conservation, held a discussion on the implementation of the B40 biodiesel program in the industrial sector, which has increased production costs in the nickel mining sector by 3-5%. The forum resulted in an initial agreement to strengthen coordination, directly involve associations, and consider policy flexibility to align with industry dynamics and global commodity prices.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia Evaluates B40 Implementation Amidst Industry Challenges
body: The Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia (APNI) has evaluated the implementation of B40, a program that has been in effect since January 2025, and reported a 3-5% increase in production costs in the nickel mining sector. The association also noted delays in supply chains in several regions, including Sulawesi Tenggara, Sulawesi Tengah, and Maluku Utara, which have impacted operational efficiency.

title: Asosiasi Penambang Nikel Indonesia Releases Nickel Price Reference for September 2025
body: The Indonesian Nickel Miners Association (APNI) has announced a decrease in the nickel price reference for the period of September 2025, with the HMA price set at $14.899,64 per dry metric ton. The association also provided detailed pricing for nickel ore with varying moisture content and nickel grades, ranging from 1.60% to 2.00%.

title: Global Nickel Prices Remain Stable, Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate Sees Significant Increase
body: The Indonesia Nickel Price Index (INPI) reported stable global nickel prices, with Mixed Hydroxide Precipitate (MHP) experiencing a significant increase of $97 per metric ton to $12,883 per metric ton. Nickel Pig Iron (NPI) saw a slight increase of $0.3 to $115.5 per metric ton, while other products such as High-Grade Nickel Matte remained stable at $13,260 per metric ton.

title: Indonesia's Energy Policy Requires Consistency and Long-Term Planning to Avoid Economic and Environmental Crisis
body: Indonesia's energy policy has been criticized for being inconsistent and driven by political motives, leading to economic losses and environmental degradation, with the country's stop-and-go policy in the mining sector being a notable example. The government must make data-driven decisions that prioritize sustainability and consistency to ensure a stable energy supply, reduce dependence on imports, and achieve its net zero emission targets.
